title: Nvidia's founder is out after 33 years, and the CFO now runs it
short: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Nvidia has its first board chair. Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/nvidia-huang-resigns-kress-interim/ #Nvidia #AIchips #Tech #Business

Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993, resigned as CEO on Thursday, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while keeping her finance job, and Harvey Jones becomes Nvidia's first board chair. Shares fell as much as 13% at the open.

The board says operations, customer commitments and the roadmap continue without interruption. Worth watching: earnings on 17 November, Washington's scrutiny of Nvidia's China dealings, and how hard a move off Nvidia would be for your own stack.
